doc.title: Al Grey interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

title: Closing remarks
summary: Woods and Grey thank each other and close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you know we really try and, it’s an honor, the whole purpose of doing these interviews was to let some of the students that are coming along that would not have seen some of these great bands personally, get to see what some of these great artists have to say. And there is something about an oral history, about just letting you talk and be yourself on camera, that brings an aliveness to it, that a textbook doesn’t do.
That’s so true. And thank you again, and I’m getting ready to do a set. Thank you.
